Star Thief#000.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#001.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#002.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#002.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#003.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#003.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#004.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.

Star Thief#010.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.

Star Thief#011.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.

Star Thief#015.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#016.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#016.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#017.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent
